feedUrls.title: Feed URLs
feedUrls.description: Threads custom feed URLs (e.g. https://www.threads.com/custom_feed/18113589370710265). Optional if searchKeywords or searchTags are provided.

searchKeywords.title: Search Keywords
searchKeywords.description: Keywords to search on Threads (e.g. "寵物醫療", "AI news"). Results come from threads.com/search.

searchTags.title: Tags / Topics
searchTags.description: Hashtags or topics to search on Threads (e.g. "#寵物友善", "tech"). Leading # is optional.

maxPosts.title: Max Posts
maxPosts.description: Maximum number of posts to scrape per source

scrollCount.title: Scroll Count
scrollCount.description: Number of times to scroll down to load more posts
